'''Jakrabs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of long-eared swift bounding [[lagomorph]]s native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Wildlife" /> and [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]].

[[File:Jakrabs-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Alarm (left), Curiosity (center), Calm (right)]]

These herbivores would get [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and [[Water/Legends|water]] from plants and shrubs relying on a small nipping beak and a wide, 180-degree vision range for protection from predators like [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]]. They had long ears which they used for hearing, heat dissipation, and communication. These ears relayed the creatures' attitude. When alarmed, they would put both ears up; when curious, they would put one ear up and leave the other down; when all was well, they would simply leave both ears down.<ref name="Wildlife" />

They sometimes hang out with [[Scurrier/Legends|scurriers]].<ref name="Wildlife" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainly'']] sourcebook, the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Point Nadir]] has an entry tunnel into the docking bay that is known as the [[Jackrab Hole]], a misspelling of this animal, after which it is named.
